reports.title: McGraw Hill, Inc. Reports Fiscal Second Quarter 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Guidance
section: We are re-affirming our fiscal year 2027 guidance, which is included below. This fiscal year 2027 guidance is forward-looking, and is based on the Company’s current expectations. Actual results may differ materially from what is indicated below.

($ in millions) | Low | High
Revenue | 2,115 | 2,175
Re-occurring Revenue | 1,587 | 1,627
Adjusted EBITDA (1) | 750 | 790
